scripts.deploy: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const isWin = process.platform === 'win32'; const cmd = isWin ? 'powershell' : 'bash'; const args = isWin ? ['-NoProfile', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', 'scripts/deploy-win.ps1', ...process.argv.slice(1)] : ['scripts/deploy-mac.sh', ...process.argv.slice(1)]; const result = spawnSync(cmd, args, { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (result.error) throw result.error; process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
scripts.start: npm install --omit=dev && npm run prisma:deploy && npm run prisma:generate && node dist/src/server.js
